subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom.

The poet had to __draw on his fancy__ to write all his sonnets.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. **use his imagination**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"draw on"** means to use something (such as a quality, resource, or skill) for a particular purpose. (साधन, गुण, या कौशल का उपयोग करना)

 
 
• **Example:** The teacher had to draw on her experience to handle the challenging situation in the classroom.
 
 
 
• **"Imagination"** refers to the ability of the mind to be creative or resourceful in thinking about things that are not real or present. (कल्पना शक्ति)
 
 
• **Example:** The artist's imagination helped her create a masterpiece that captured the beauty of nature.
 
 
 
• In the given sentence, the poet "drew on his fancy," which implies he used his imagination to compose his sonnets. (यहां कवि ने अपनी कल्पना शक्ति का उपयोग किया।)

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. **use his imagination**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: Use his clothes **(अपने कपड़ों का उपयोग करना): This option is irrelevant to the context of the sentence.

 
 
• **Example:** He decided to use his clothes as a makeshift pillow during the journey.
 
 
 
• **Option 2: Use his memory **(अपनी स्मृति का उपयोग करना): This refers to recalling past events or experiences.
 
 
• **Example:** She used her memory to recreate the events of the day in her diary.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: Use his money **(अपने पैसे का उपयोग करना): This implies spending or utilizing financial resources.
 
 
• **Example:** He had to use his money to pay for the unexpected medical expenses.
